description: axe-core + keyboard smoke targets for the core Extend-aligned components (#165). The page under test is the built parity comparison app (tools/vue-reference/dist), which renders the real `@arcships/vue-ui` / `@arcships/vue-pdf` components in light and dark themes.

axe.description: Rules matching these WCAG tags run against the surface root. `tests/a11y/allowlist.json` records the pre-existing violations; anything not listed fails the run.

checks.focusable: Tab from the document reaches an interactive control inside the surface.
checks.focus-indicator: The focused control paints an outline or a ring (box-shadow), so keyboard focus stays visible.
checks.accessible-name: The focused control exposes an accessible name (aria-labelledby, aria-label, label, text, alt, title).
checks.select-opens-on-arrow: ArrowDown on a combobox trigger opens a listbox; Escape closes it.

surfaces.notes: The dialog is controlled by the harness with open=true, so Escape cannot be observed here; the close button is reachable with Tab and labelled.
The thumbnail card is not interactive; axe-core covers its image alt text.
